address: 227 rue des Pionniers, Tadoussac, G0T 2A0, Canada
bio: Welcome to Tadoussac! This remote, windswept village lies at the confluence of the Saguenay Fjord and St Lawrence River. This site of exceptional marine biodiversity is where Mireille (who is from the region) and Jean-Sébastien chose to set up shop. Over the years they have built up the reputation of their restaurant, which is very busy during the five months of the year it is open. The chef devises two tasting menus, one devoted to produce from the land—vegetables from the kitchen garden, forest plants and game; the other centered on the best the St Lawrence River has to offer: snow crab, red tuna, lobster, and halibut. Seasonings are kept simple and well-balanced, leaving plenty of room for the flavors of the ingredients to come through....
